title: Auction formation and reserve terms
summary: The bidding and closing mechanism determines which act creates the sale.
notes: The textbook discusses the ordinary role of bids as offers, the auctioneer’s completion of the sale, and limits on withdrawal in an auction without reserve. It distinguishes the owner’s withdrawal question from a bidder’s ability to retract before completion. An analogy to a land auction is not a direct application of Article 2 to land. The Foley problem asks about an agent’s mistaken listing of a reserve auction as no-reserve.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 203–205. Open assigned page 203.
